title: Women's Health and Fitness Day is my reminder to book a checkup
dek: National Women's Health and Fitness Day falls on September 30, and I am finally putting that overdue checkup on the calendar.
keywords: national womens health and fitness day
body: Three in the morning is when my brain likes to bring up everything I have been putting off. Tonight it reminded me that I have not scheduled a routine checkup in longer than I would like to admit.

The timing fits, because September 30 is National Women's Health and Fitness Day, a day that promotes women's health at every age. I think it is a useful nudge for anyone, since so many of us take care of other people's appointments and let our own slide to the bottom of the list.

I used to wait until something felt wrong before calling a doctor. Now I try to think of a checkup as ordinary maintenance, the same way I think about an oil change. It is easier to book when I feel fine, and I usually leave with fewer worries than I walked in with.

The fitness side of the day does not have to be complicated either. A walk around the block after lunch, a few minutes of stretching before bed, or taking the stairs once or twice a day all add up over time.
Since you cannot call the office right now, write a note on your phone that says to book the appointment. Set a reminder for 9 a.m., and make the call before the day gets busy.
